_comment: Edit this file to match YOUR Create ML models. Keys that start with '_' are ignored. No code changes needed.

models._comment: File names WITHOUT extension. Drop <name>.mlmodel into UrbanHarvest/Models/ and re-run `xcodegen generate`.

detection._comment: Detections below this confidence (0..1) are ignored. imageCropAndScale: scaleFill | scaleFit | centerCrop.

advisor._comment: Which column your tabular regressor predicts: defect_rate | yield_kg_per_m2 | auto (read from the model's output name).

labels._comment: Exact labels from your detector (case-insensitive). Every label you trained must appear in one of the two buckets.

keywords._comment: Fallback when a label is not listed above: the label is split on _ - and spaces; if any word matches, it goes to that bucket. Defect is checked first.

unknownLabel._comment: What to do with a label matched by nothing above: ignore | good | defect.

displayNames._comment: Optional: text shown on the bounding box instead of the raw label.
